name: duel-1
title: The duel, the contact dance: two virtual players running at each other, catching, swinging and flinging each other, launching off and landing on each other, free in third person with the HUD, a few seconds locked to show the option; the temple, then the forge. Each shot is the duel from its first frame (the count-in, then play), the brains seeded, deterministic.

shots.note: the temple's court, its arena (drums, lintels, drops): fire, a flyer (leaps at the other to be caught, lifts off its hands, wall kicks, flips), with water, a lead (catches, swings, flings); free from the count-in, then at 11 s the lock (the stage plane through the court) for the last five seconds
the sky forge's floating stones over the void (a fall reforms in a moment): water, a base (plants, catches what comes, swings it), with fire, a flyer
